test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence.

Ruma plays carrom very well.

options.text: Carrom is played very well by Ruma.
Carrom was played very well by Ruma.
Carrom is playing very well by Ruma.
Carrom has been played very well by Ruma.

solution:
The correct answer is **Carrom is played very well by Ruma.**
